prompt: How does the kubelet on a kubeadm control plane start the API server?
hint: It cannot ask the API server to start itself.

choices.why: A Deployment needs a running API server.

choices.text: As a systemd service kubeadm wrote
choices.why: Only the kubelet itself is a service.

choices.text: From a DaemonSet on control-plane nodes
choices.why: Also needs the API server first.

prompt: A kubeadm cluster was never upgraded. What breaks on its first birthday?

choices.why: They last 24 hours, not a year.

prompt: Put in order the steps to remove a worker node for good.
hint: Move the work while the node is still in the cluster.
trap: Deleting the Node first leaves its pods with nowhere to report.

prompt: What does `--discovery-token-ca-cert-hash` protect a joining node from?

choices.text: Joining a control plane that is not yours

choices.why: The token is checked by the control plane.
Versions are not in the hash.

choices.text: Running out of pod addresses on the new node

prompt: Why treat a join token like a password?

choices.text: It contains the admin's password in plain text
It lets a machine join as a node
choices.why: Right, and a node reads its pods' Secrets.

prompt: A cluster runs three etcd members. Why does it still need backups?
hint: What happens to a mistaken delete?

choices.text: Three members cannot elect a leader
Snapshots are needed to start etcd
choices.why: etcd starts from its data directory.

prompt: Why is the snapshot copied off the control-plane node?

choices.text: etcd deletes snapshots after an hour
choices.why: It does not touch the file.

choices.text: The restore runs only on the laptop
choices.why: It ran on the node here.

choices.text: It would be lost with the node
It is too large for the node's disk

prompt: Put in order the steps of the etcd restore in this lesson.
items: `etcdutl snapshot restore` into a new directory
Change the etcd manifest's data path
trap: Restoring under a running etcd corrupts both.

prompt: Backups run every night at 02:00. The cluster is lost at 17:00 and restored. What is missing?

choices.why: The log was lost with the cluster.
Everything is restored to the same moment.
Node objects come back with the snapshot.
